blocks.text: I’d choose the earlier-arriving Aeroplan award if getting to Bangkok sooner matters most. The tradeoff is leaving San Francisco 11h30 earlier and spending 5 minutes longer in transit; the other shown award leaves later and has the slightly shorter elapsed time.
